cases.explain: «последние дни» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

cases.sentence: Земледельцу тоже приходится терпеливо ждать ___ земли, пока он получит осенние и весенние дожди .
cases.explain: «драгоценного плода» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

cases.explain: «хвалебные песни» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
